name: alphabetsoup-extension
description: AlphabetSoup browser extension — NATO phonetic alphabet parser

scripts.build:firefox: cross-env BROWSER=firefox vite build && node scripts/patch-firefox.js
scripts.build:all: npm run build:chrome && npm run build:edge && npm run build:firefox
scripts.zip:chrome: npm run build:chrome && cd dist-chrome && zip -r ../alphabetsoup-chrome.zip . -x '*.map'
scripts.zip:edge: npm run build:edge && cd dist-edge && zip -r ../alphabetsoup-edge.zip . -x '*.map'
scripts.zip:firefox: npm run build:firefox && cd dist-firefox && zip -r ../alphabetsoup-firefox.zip . -x '*.map'
